intended_object: The canonical projection natural transformation G ⟶ G/i(H). Here i : H ⟶ G is a natural transformation of group-valued functors whose image at each object is normal, and the projection's component at X is the quotient map G(X) → G(X)/i_X(H(X)). This comes from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The component at X is `QuotientGroup.mk' (i.app X).hom.range`, the quotient map onto `G.obj X ⧸ range (i.app X)`. That is exactly the object `quotient i` takes at X. Naturality holds by `rfl`, since `QuotientGroup.map` acts on representatives. The setting is already general: any category C and any group-valued functors, and normality of the images is the only hypothesis, which is needed for the quotients to be groups. Mathlib has no general pointwise quotient of group-valued functors by a natural transformation, so there is nothing broader to point to. The definition matches the intended canonical projection.
